semiconductor_relevance: High — Sanyu Rec Co., Ltd. provides essential materials for semiconductor packaging and assembly, including encapsulation and underfill products.
summary: Sanyu Rec Co., Ltd. specializes in the development and manufacturing of semiconductor materials, focusing on epoxy and urethane encapsulation products. Their offerings include Liquid MUF, UF, DA, and Mold Sheets, which are critical for semiconductor packaging and assembly processes.
